title: The Ants Are Moving
subtitle: They know it's going to rain before I do
style: children's book illustration drawn with wax crayons on textured paper, chunky crayon strokes, visible waxy grain, flat bright colors, naive childlike drawing, thick black outlines, simple shapes, storybook art
neg_extra: watercolor painting, oil painting, 3d render, smooth airbrush gradient, swarm of insects, scribble, messy tangled black lines, giant insect

pages.zh:
太阳出来了，我跑到院子里玩。
咦？地上有一条细细的黑线。
它还在动！
我蹲下来，慢慢靠近。
pages.scene: A sunny backyard garden path with brown soil and yellow flowers along the edges. In the foreground a thin wavy black line of tiny ants crosses the path. The little boy crouches a few steps behind it, leaning forward with curious eyes, slowly getting closer.
pages.en:
The sun is out, so I run into the yard to play.
Huh? There's a thin black line on the ground.
And it's moving!
I crouch down and creep closer.

pages.zh:
原来不是线——
是好多好多蚂蚁，
一只跟着一只，排着队走。
比我排队走得还好。
pages.scene: A long line of many small black ants, one behind another, walking across the ground in a single file that stretches from one side of the picture to the other.
pages.en:
It isn't a line at all—
it's lots and lots of ants,
one behind the other, marching in a row.
They line up even better than I do.

pages.zh:
每一只都扛着东西。
一粒米，一点饼干渣，一小片树叶。
最小的那只，
扛的东西比它自己还大。
爸爸说，蚂蚁是大力士。
pages.scene: Close view of brown garden soil with a line of black ants, each carrying something on its back: a grain of rice, a biscuit crumb, a small green leaf. The smallest ant carries a crumb bigger than itself. Sunlit ground, small plants at the edges, only the ants and the ground in the picture.
pages.en:
Every single one is carrying something.
A grain of rice, a cookie crumb, a tiny piece of leaf.
The littlest ant
is carrying something bigger than itself.
Dad says ants are super strong.

pages.zh:
它们把土一粒一粒搬出来，
在洞口堆成一座小山。
搬完一趟，又回去搬下一趟。
我数到十，就数乱了。
pages.scene: A small cone shaped mound of loose soil at an ant nest entrance on brown ground, black ants walking in and out, each carrying one grain of dirt, garden plants around, only the ants, the soil and the plants in the picture.
pages.en:
They carry the dirt out one grain at a time
and pile it into a tiny hill by the door.
When one trip is done, they go back for another.
I count to ten… and then I lose count.

pages.zh:
两只蚂蚁走到一起，
碰了碰头上的小触角。
「你好呀。」
「那边有好吃的！」
它们不用嘴巴说话，
用触角。
pages.scene: Simple crayon drawing at ground level on light paper: two cute black ants with round bodies and thick black crayon outlines face each other in the middle of the picture, gently touching their antennae together, a few chunky crayon blades of green grass around them.
pages.en:
Two ants meet
and touch the little feelers on their heads.
“Hello!”
“There's yummy food over there!”
They don't talk with their mouths.
They talk with their feelers.

pages.zh:
我跟着队伍走到一个小洞口。
蚂蚁一只接一只钻进去，
就像回家一样。
它们怎么认得路？
前面的留下气味，后面的闻着走。
我也闻了闻，什么都没闻到。
pages.scene: The little boy walks slowly along the garden path, bent over, following a long line of black ants that leads to a small round hole in the dirt with a little mound of soil around it. The ants disappear into the hole one after another.
pages.en:
I follow the line to a tiny hole.
The ants go in one after another,
like they're going home.
How do they know the way?
The ants in front leave a smell behind, and the ones in back follow it.
I sniff too. I can't smell a thing.

pages.zh:
咦，天忽然暗下来了。
风来了，草哗啦啦地响。
我的头发，被吹得跳起舞来。
pages.scene: The little boy stands in a grassy yard looking up at the sky, dark storm clouds rushing overhead, wind bending the tall grass and blowing his hair, a big darkening sky filling the upper two thirds of the picture.
pages.en:
Huh—the sky suddenly gets dark.
The wind comes, and the grass goes swish, swish.
My hair starts dancing in the wind.

pages.zh:
妈妈在门口喊：「要下雨啦，快回来！」
蚂蚁们也在急急忙忙往家跑。
跑得比我还快。
妈妈说，空气变潮的时候，
蚂蚁就知道要下雨了。
它们比我先知道。
pages.scene: A garden path under a dark stormy crayon sky with the first big raindrops falling. In the foreground a busy line of black ants hurries along the ground toward a small hole in the dirt, each ant carrying a tiny white crumb in its jaws. Grass and flowers bend in the wind along the path.
pages.en:
Mom calls from the door, “It's going to rain! Come inside!”
The ants are hurrying home too.
They're even faster than me.
Mom says when the air gets damp,
ants know that rain is coming.
They know before I do.

pages.zh:
它们的家有好多个门，
藏在草丛里，藏在石头下面。
妈妈说，一个蚂蚁的家里，
住着好几万只蚂蚁。
地底下，一座大城市。
pages.scene: Brown ground with several small ant nest holes, some half hidden under grass and one under a flat stone, a few black ants at each hole, late afternoon warm light.
pages.en:
Their home has lots of doors,
hidden in the grass and under the rocks.
Mom says one ant home
has tens of thousands of ants living in it.
Under the ground, there's a whole big city.

pages.zh:
滴答，滴答。
下雨啦。
我躲在伞下面，
蚂蚁躲在家里面。
我们都听得见雨声。
pages.scene: Rain falling on the garden. The little boy stands under a big yellow umbrella, smiling and listening, raindrops bouncing off the umbrella. Near his feet a small ant hole is sheltered under a big green leaf. Wet grass, small puddles, cozy warm mood.
pages.en:
Drip, drop.
It's raining.
I hide under my umbrella,
and the ants hide in their home.
We can all hear the rain.

character: wearing a green short sleeve t-shirt and dark blue shorts, white socks and grey sneakers, short black hair
scale: consistent character proportions across all pages, a small three year old toddler
